mapper.select: SELECT class_course_id, bco.course_name, sum(IF(actually_num IS NULL, 0, actually_num)) actually_num, sum(IF(late_num IS NULL, 0, late_num)) late_num, sum(IF(leave_num IS NULL, 0, leave_num)) leave_num, sum(IF(not_arrived IS NULL, 0, not_arrived)) not_arrived FROM bd_class bc LEFT JOIN ( SELECT class_id, sum(IF(type = 0, 1, 0)) actually_num, sum(IF(type = 1, 1, 0)) late_num, sum(IF(type = 2 OR type = 4, 1, 0)) leave_num, sum(IF(type = 3, 1, 0)) not_arrived FROM bd_call_record WHERE is_delete = 0 GROUP BY class_id ) bcr ON bcr.class_id = bc.id LEFT JOIN bd_course bco ON bco.id = bc.class_course_id WHERE bc.mec_id = #{mecId} and bc.campus_id = #{campusId} and bc.is_delete = 0 and bc.class_state = 0 GROUP BY class_course_id
